proposed.explanation: Unprimed latex allows moisture absorption and mold on substrate. Wallpaper without fungicide base primer is unsuitable for high humidity. Unprimed enamel offers no substrate seal or mold protection. High-humidity bathrooms require fungicide-treated primer to prevent mold and mildew on the drywall substrate. Boysen and Davies offer fungicide-rich primers designed for tropical climates. Latex topcoat over fungicide primer provides durable, mold-resistant finish. High-humidity zones = fungicide primer + paint topcoat. Never skip primer. Boysen, Davies have proven fungicide formulations.
